decisions.reason: Its non-core consumer positioning and low strategic option value make it likely to be dropped, freeing resources for the firm's many core technology options.
As a modular extension of the core waste-to-energy line with unresolved upside, its option value justifies the carrying cost.
As a flagship with a dedicated website page and strategic alignment, it retains high option value and should be kept.
As a flagship close to established capabilities, its option value supports continued investment.
